title: agentopt version report
description: The structured source of truth for one improvement outcome (.agentopt/reports/report-*.json). Markdown/HTML (and the existing versions/vN.md) are RENDERED from this — numbers live here once, never duplicated across formats. Covers both accepted changes (a version) and rejected candidates (a run-level debug report). References the decision and scorecards by path.

version.description: History version created on acceptance, e.g. 'v5'. Null for a rejected candidate.

decision_ref.description: Relative path to the decision-*.json this report renders. Null until the structured decision artifact is emitted.

changes.description: Files the candidate edited (null for a tier that changes no source, e.g. a pure param/overlay).

cost.description: Operational summary for the run (feeds the lexicographic tiebreakers later).

ledger_attempt_id.description: Foreign key into ledger.json — links the report to reward memory and to rollback.

rollback_command.description: The exact undo, e.g. 'agentopt rollback v5'. Null for a rejected candidate.

presentation.description: Render hints only — no decision data.
